text:
Renee (CS): Heads-up: Aurelius Labs renewal is approx 6 weeks out (2026-07-02). Platform usage dropped ~63% over last 30d. Active seats 26 -> 9. Champion moved to a new company. Need a focused triage and an outreach plan by EOW.

Mark (CSM): Noted. Any signals on why? Competitor trial or tech issues?

Renee (CS): Procurement pinged us: they're running a 2-week on-prem demo with VectorWorks (competitor). Also a security audit triggered by a regulator asking for data-residency proofs.

Anya (RevOps): Billing shows embeddings -61%, gen tokens -58%. No late invoices. I can prepare a short retention concession if we run a controlled POC.

Lukas (Eng): No latency or error anomalies on our infra. The residency/audit ask could be the blocker if VectorWorks promises local-hosted option.

Pri (Support): Support ticket from their SRE: "Can you confirm we can restrict model KV cache to EU-hosted nodes?" I replied asking for the precise compliance checklist.

Renee (CS): So two pressure points: (1) competitor POC, (2) compliance/residency ask. We need a dual offer: a technical bake-off + a short Dedicated-private demo addressing residency.

Mark (CSM): Proposed plan: 1) Offer a 10-day Dedicated-private trial (EU nodes) with trial waiver; 2) Run a blind bake-off with objective metrics; 3) Offer an enablement + migration credit if they commit. Thoughts?

Anya (RevOps): I can draft a 2-week POC pricing addendum: 30% off embedding units during trial + $12k migration/enablement credit tied to 12-mo deal. Need legal signoff.

Lukas (Eng): I'll build a reproducible harness: sanitized 1k-doc set, two evaluation tasks (semantic search + clinical summarization), metrics: precision@5, mean cosine gap, and lead-time-to-first-result. I'll also document how we pin KV cache to EU rack for the demo. Will push to /shared/aurelius/bakeoff.

Pri (Support): Snippet I can run for perf numbers:
```
python infra/bench.py --dataset aurelius_1k.json --model rwd-embed-eu --batch 128
```
I'll attach tail latency and memory profile by EOD.

audit-bot: Compliance note: customer requested data residency attestation on 2026-05-18.

Renee (CS): Important outreach: include new internal stakeholders: Lina (Head of Compliance) and Mateo (Head of Data Ops). Mark, can you get updated contacts?

Mark (CSM): Got it. Reached out to Mateo and Lina; tentative kickoff Thu 2pm BST.

Anya (RevOps): I'll prepare the concession language and the residency checklist doc. Legal needs to approve the private trial waiver (no export of logs outside EU).

Lukas (Eng): For fairness in the bake-off, we should provide an eval checklist and a seed-run notebook. I'll include scripts to compute precision@k and cosine-gap and a deterministic seed.

Pri (Support): I'll standby for any repro during the trial and help with quick config changes.

Renee (CS): If VectorWorks demonstrates cost parity and residency, then the retention play should emphasize our migration path, SLA, and third-party audit certifications. Anya, can you quantify a migration timeline estimate?

Anya (RevOps): Tentative migration timeline: 6-8 weeks for Dedicated-private onboarding + compliance attestation. I'll include that in the one-pager.

Mark (CSM): Invite sent for Thu 2pm BST. Included objectives: match or exceed precision@5 (target >= 0.77), 95th pct latency <= 150ms on EU nodes, and residency attestation provided.

Lukas (Eng): Bench harness pushed at commit 9b2c. Link: https://redwood.internal/aurelius/bakeoff. README includes reproduction steps and metric definitions.

audit-bot: Trial waiver template attached by Anya.

Renee (CS): Great. Action owners: Mark (stakeholder outreach & invite), Anya (pricing & compliance doc), Lukas (bench harness & EU pinning instructions), Pri (support during POC). Reconvene after the bake-off for results and decision on retention credit. :white_check_mark:

Mark (CSM): Thanks team. I'll update after the kickoff.
